CREATE TABLE `learning_courses` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `category_key` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cover_locator` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gradient_token` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `access_level` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `sort_order` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `origin` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `imported_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_learning_course_run` (`migration_run_id`),
  KEY `idx_learning_course_list` (`status`,`sort_order`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_course_run` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_course_access` CHECK (((`access_level` is null) or (cast(`access_level` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'free' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'logged_in' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'plus_pro' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'pro_only' as char charset binary))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_course_hash` CHECK (((`source_sha256` is null) or ((char_length(`source_sha256`) = 64) and (not(regexp_like(`source_sha256`,_utf8mb4'[^0-9a-f]',_utf8mb4'c')))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_course_native` CHECK (((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) <> cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) or ((`created_at_utc` is not null) and (`access_level` is not null) and (`status` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_course_origin` CHECK ((((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) and (`updated_at_utc` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null)) or ((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'legacy_import' as char charset binary)) and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_course_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_course_status` CHECK (((`status` is null) or (cast(`status` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'draft' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'published' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'archived' as char charset binary)))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `learning_lessons` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `course_id` int NOT NULL,
  `public_episode_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `display_number` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `content_type` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `duration_ms` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `origin` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `imported_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_learning_episode` (`public_episode_id`),
  KEY `fk_learning_lesson_run` (`migration_run_id`),
  KEY `idx_learning_lesson_course` (`course_id`,`sort_order`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_lesson_course` FOREIGN KEY (`course_id`) REFERENCES `learning_courses` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_lesson_run` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_lesson_duration` CHECK (((`duration_ms` is null) or (`duration_ms` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_lesson_hash` CHECK (((`source_sha256` is null) or ((char_length(`source_sha256`) = 64) and (not(regexp_like(`source_sha256`,_utf8mb4'[^0-9a-f]',_utf8mb4'c')))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_lesson_id` CHECK (((`public_episode_id` is null) or (`public_episode_id` > 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_lesson_native` CHECK (((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) <> cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) or ((`created_at_utc` is not null) and (`content_type` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_lesson_origin` CHECK ((((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) and (`updated_at_utc` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null)) or ((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'legacy_import' as char charset binary)) and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_lesson_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_lesson_type` CHECK (((`content_type` is null) or (cast(`content_type` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'video' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'article' as char charset binary)))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `learning_media_references` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `lesson_id` int NOT NULL,
  `source_kind` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `locator` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `origin` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `imported_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_learning_media_kind` (`lesson_id`,`source_kind`),
  KEY `fk_learning_media_run` (`migration_run_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_media_lesson` FOREIGN KEY (`lesson_id`) REFERENCES `learning_lessons` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_media_run` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_media_hash` CHECK (((`source_sha256` is null) or ((char_length(`source_sha256`) = 64) and (not(regexp_like(`source_sha256`,_utf8mb4'[^0-9a-f]',_utf8mb4'c')))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_media_kind` CHECK ((cast(`source_kind` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'youtube_id' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'bilibili_id' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'cf_stream_id' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'local_video_path' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'article_url' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'article_object_key' as char charset binary)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_media_locator` CHECK ((length(`locator`) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_media_native` CHECK (((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) <> cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) or (`created_at_utc` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_media_origin` CHECK ((((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) and (`updated_at_utc` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null)) or ((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'legacy_import' as char charset binary)) and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_media_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `learning_progress` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `lesson_id` int NOT NULL,
  `watched_ms` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `reported_duration_ms` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `completed` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `quiz_passed` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `origin` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `imported_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_learning_progress_user_lesson` (`user_id`,`lesson_id`),
  KEY `fk_learning_progress_run` (`migration_run_id`),
  KEY `idx_learning_progress_lesson` (`lesson_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_progress_lesson` FOREIGN KEY (`lesson_id`) REFERENCES `learning_lessons` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_progress_run` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_learning_progress_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_progress_completed` CHECK (((`completed` is null) or (`completed` in (0,1)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_progress_duration` CHECK (((`reported_duration_ms` is null) or (`reported_duration_ms` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_progress_hash` CHECK (((`source_sha256` is null) or ((char_length(`source_sha256`) = 64) and (not(regexp_like(`source_sha256`,_utf8mb4'[^0-9a-f]',_utf8mb4'c')))))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_progress_origin` CHECK ((((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'native' as char charset binary)) and (`updated_at_utc` is not null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null)) or ((cast(`origin` as char charset binary) = cast(_utf8mb4'legacy_import' as char charset binary)) and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_progress_quiz` CHECK (((`quiz_passed` is null) or (`quiz_passed` in (0,1)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_progress_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_learning_progress_watched` CHECK (((`watched_ms` is null) or (`watched_ms` >= 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
